description: Switches an existing rendering on an item with an alternate one. The switched instance gets a NEW uniqueId (SPE regenerates it); the tool returns one row per switched instance with the new UniqueId, RenderingID, Placeholder and Datasource — use that UniqueId for any follow-up call, the old one no longer exists.

database.description: The context database. Sent when addressing by ID -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Target the final layout (default true), where list-renderings' uniqueIds live. False = shared only.

id.description: The ID of the item holding the renderings. Supply this or path.

language.description: The language version of the item holding the renderings.

newRenderingId.description: The ID of the new rendering. Supply this or newRenderingPath.

newRenderingPath.description: The path of the new rendering. Supply this or newRenderingId.

oldRenderingId.description: The ID of the rendering to switch; every instance of it on the item is switched. Supply this, oldRenderingPath or uniqueId.

oldRenderingPath.description: The path of the rendering to switch; every instance of it on the item is switched. Supply this, oldRenderingId or uniqueId.

path.description: The path of the item holding the renderings. Supply this or id.

uniqueId.description: The unique ID of the rendering instance to switch. Supply this, oldRenderingId or oldRenderingPath.

name: presentation-switch-rendering
